high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "narendramodi." The post shows a photograph of a formal event taking place under a white tent. There are several individuals in the background, some of whom appear to be staff or security personnel, while others are dressed formally. In the foreground, there is a man with a white beard and glasses, wearing an orange Nehru jacket over a white kurta. He is seated at a table with a bouquet of pink and yellow roses placed on it. A woman, who appears to be an interviewer, is holding a microphone and is seated across from him.
